text: Ethereum is outpacing Bitcoin today with a 2.6% gain versus Bitcoin's 0.9%, suggesting traders are rotating into altcoins despite Bitcoin holding steady near $77k. The Fear & Greed index at 71 combined with a sharp 37-point jump over the week indicates strong positive momentum, though Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 58.8%, showing the market hasn't fully abandoned its largest asset. Volume of $161B reflects active trading conditions, with smaller-cap assets like SOL and BNB gaining more percentage ground, typical of risk-on sentiment when broader confidence is high.
